name: 5 -Five-
source:
"five little love tales which are likely to be buried in snow"

The main character visits a town covered with snow. He stays at a farm with his sister and some girls, enjoying his life there. However, they face various fates as time goes by and try to go forward... What will happen to them at the end of the story...? 

[From ErogeShop]
